meta_description:
108 likes, 1 comments - drsnehal_adsule on October 6, 2026: "Some of my slightly cringe little rituals that have helped me stay consistent with food for years 😂

And honestly, none of them are complicated.

The first one is probably the most boring:

My breakfast is almost the same every single day.

Two eggs + one slice of bread.

Because I genuinely don’t want to make food decisions before 9 a.m. 😂

On days I can’t have eggs, I’ll have poha because it’s my favourite.

I’ve realised that having a few “default meals” takes away so much decision-making.

I don’t wake up thinking, “What should I eat today?”

I already know.

The second one is my warm water ritual.

The moment I wake up, I have warm water.

I’ve been doing this for almost 7 years now.

And honestly, it’s less about the water and more about what it represents for me.

It’s the first little thing I do every morning that tells my brain, “I’m taking care of myself today.”

That feeling of starting my day right makes it easier for me to continue making good choices through the day.

And yes, I also find it comforting for my tummy.

The third one is something I started doing when I’m eating around other people.

I don’t put a huge portion on my plate.

I serve myself a little, eat slowly, and if I’m actually still hungry, I can always take more.

Because I’ve noticed that when there’s a lot of food sitting in front of me, I’m much more likely to mindlessly finish it just because it’s there.

And there’s another funny psychological trick here.

I’ve kind of created an identity for myself around food: I’m not someone who hogs.

So when I’m at a restaurant or eating with people, I naturally become more mindful about how much I’m eating.

It sounds silly.

But these tiny rituals have helped me more than trying to be “disciplined” all the time.

Because consistency isn’t about making the perfect choice every day.

It’s about creating little systems that make the right choice easier.

If you want me to help you create a simple Desi fat-loss routine that you can actually follow in your real life, comment PLAN below…

I’ll send you the details in the DMs💜".
